text: Milverton Boulevard is a two-way residential street north of Danforth Avenue. Residents along Milverton Boulevard are concerned about vehicles speeding along their street and they have submitted a petition in favour of installing traffic calming on Milverton Boulevard between Greenwood Avenue and Linsmore Crescent. I will also be circulating a ballot to the residents along this section of Milverton Boulevard to gauge their support for speed hump installation.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested Transportation staff to conduct a study for the installation of speed humps on Milverton Boulevard between Greenwood Avenue and Linsmore Crescent and report back with their findings to Toronto and East York Community Council at its meeting on September 16, 2019.
